desc: Confirm algorithm: condition that no W cell lies at intersection of a row with B and a column with B.
Implement `solve()` using fast I/O: parse all ints and chars.
For each entry: if C_i == 'B', add X_i to rows_with_B and Y_i to cols_with_B; else (W) store (X_i, Y_i).
After reading, iterate over stored W cells; if any has row in `rows_with_B` and column in `cols_with_B`, print "No" and exit.
Test mentally with sample inputs (Sample 1: Yes, Sample 2: No, Sample 3: Yes, Sample 4: No).
Wrap code in required delimiters and output to STDOUT.
